simple.meaning: שֶׂה (seh) appears 47 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering from the firstborn of the flock and its fat. The surrounding account also brings the name into blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 22:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, flock, offering, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׂה (H7716) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שֶׂה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שֶׂה (seh) / H7716 is tracked through Genesis 22:7, Genesis 22:8, Genesis 30:32, Exodus 12:3. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat
definitions.usage: (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare 2089 .
definitions.full: H7716. seh שֶׂה noun masculine Gen 30:32 and (less often) feminine Jer 50:17 one of a flock, a sheep (or goat) (Assyrian šuju , Arabic plural , , etc. (also wild ox ), compare Egyptian sau , sheep Bondi 65 , compare Id Ba NB§ 2 b ς ); — absolute שֶׂה Gen 30:32 +, construct שֵׂה Isa 43:23 +; suffix שֵׂיוֺ Deut 22:1 , שְׂיֵ֫הוּ 1Sam 14:34 ; not in plural; — 1 a sheep , or goat , noun of individual meaning of צאֹן : as property Gen 32:32 (twice in verse) (J; + עאֹן collective, עִזִּים כְּשָׂבִים, ), Exodus 21:37 (twice in verse) (+ צאֹן שׁוֺר, collective), Exod 22:3 (+ חֲמוֺר שׁוֺר, , V:8 ( id. ), V:9 ( id ; all E); Deut 22:1 (+ שׁוֺר ), 1Sam 17:34 ( זה Kt van d. H. erroneous, see Baer Dr), roaming pasture Isa 7:25 , straying Psa 119:176 (simile), slaughtered Isa 53:7 (in simile); + חֲמוֺר שׁוֺר, Judg 6:4 ; 1Sam 22:19 ; Josh 6:21 (J), + id. + גָּמָל 1Sam 15:3 ; as sacrifice Gen 22:7-8 , (J), Exod 13:13 ; Lev 5:12 ; 12:8 ; Num 15:11 ( ׳שׂ בָּעִזִּים אוֺ בַּכְּבָשִׂים ; all P), Deut 18:3 (+ שׁוֺר ), Isa 43:23 ; 66:3 (+ שׁוֺר ), מִןהַֿצּאֹן Ezek 45:15 ; compare Exod 34:19 (+ שׁוֺר ), ᵑ9 20 (J), Leviticus 26 (P; + שׁוֺר ); fit for sacrifice Lev 22:28 (H); unfit ᵑ9 23 (H), Deut 17:1 (both + שׁוֺר ); as food 1Sam 14:34 (+ שׁוֺר ), שׂ ׳עִזִּים וְשׂ ׳כְּשָׂבִים Deut 14:4 (+ id.); for Passover Exod 12:3 (twice in verse); 12:4 (twice in verse); 12:5 (P); figurative of Israel Ezek 34:17 (twice in verse) (|| עַתּוּדִים אֵילִים, ), 34:20 ; 34:20 ; 34:22 ; 34:22 . 2 collective flock: פְזוּרָה שֶׂה Jer 50:17 (= אֹבְדוֺת צאֹן 50:6 ).
